title: cyclosorus wailele
intro: Cyclosorus wailele, commonly known as the Wailele fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Hawaiian medicine to treat various health issues. Research suggests that the Wailele fern has potential health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing inflammation and improving wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the Wailele fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that may be responsible for its medicinal effects.
